Bible Word Evolution

Warning about a wording change: Charles replaces the name "yahweh" with the word "god" everywhere in this program as a personal reading choice that helps Charles follow the quotes which means the quotes here differ from the World English Bible at every place where the World English Bible prints the name.

Ten separate agents each start from one random word and every paste copies a string with a chance of adding or swapping or changing one whole word and no deleting while a reader favors strings that hold more short quotes from the World English Bible.

Which part of the Bible the words and quotes come from

Every quote is a piece of at most 44 letters cut from the World English Bible which is a modern English translation that anyone may copy freely. The random words that agents add are drawn from the same selection and common words such as "the" are drawn more often because the draw follows how often each word appears.

String the reader likes most right now

Complete quotes show underlined in color and leftover words show faded because the reader only gives full credit to complete quotes. A longer quote earns more credit than a shorter quote because credit grows with the number of words.

Average number of quotes over experiment time

The line shows how many different quotes the best string of an average agent holds which means a rising line shows the agents are still finding new quotes.

The best string of each separate agent

Each agent keeps a private pool of strings and never sees the strings of another agent which means each agent can end up with different text.
